events.fact: Eighty-eight-year-old writer Dmytro shops for a private pre-birthday celebration and meets his son John.
Dmytro dies in his sleep and wakes in a bureaucratic purgatory interview, restored to age thirty.
Nataliia reads his biography, explains the scoring system and describes his personal heaven.
Dmytro asks about God, other souls, hell, memories and the modernized commandments.
In his heaven Dmytro meets God and asks where ducks fly in winter; God says he does not know.
